scope: Retained component notice and final-code attribution closure. Evidence remains bounded by explicit per-component findings; no legal certification.

indexNameRule.rule: readFunctions assigns Name::fromInt(i) using the zero-based defined-function ordinal. Later nameless-input -g probes retain that input ordinal even after output reordering.

method.postlinkProof: First -O3 pass retains linker names with -g. Later probes read each ORIGINAL nameless retained input and emit generated index names, avoiding name-dependent optimizer ordering. Sidecars transfer prior-stage names by checked input ordinal. Every complete non-custom section is compared byte-for-byte at each checkpoint and final; added-name diagnostic files are never counted as exact whole runtime rebuilds.
method.negativeEvidenceLimit: A missing final symbol cannot exclude inlined code, folded code or static data. Compiler header inclusion is not evidence that header implementation survives.
method.discardedProbe: The initial propagated-name metadce experiment reordered types/functions and failed section identity. It is excluded from successful evidence; raw outputs remain external.

findings.status: positive-final-contribution; missing binary material prepared for reissue
findings.explanation: The selected retro_utils.o emits file_exists; selected retro_vfs.o directly calls it. The surviving final retro_vfs_exists contains the stat fallback and its permission/directory masks384 and16384. The bounded structural correspondence supports incorporated final logic despite inlining removing the original utility function names.
findings.distributionCondition: The complete source notice requires reproducing its copyright, conditions and disclaimer in documentation and/or other materials accompanying redistribution. Existing November6 standalone package and release-notice ZIP omit the full notice; source archives preserve it.

findings.explanation: Selected non-LTO m6502.o matches the compiler output; Reset6502 and Int6502 survive in the exact-runtime-equivalent final function inventory. Earlier machine notice spans captured only individual copyright lines, so three complete banners now preserve all nearby terms.
findings.distributionCondition: The banners prohibit commercial distribution and request notification of changes. They do not separately state a binary documentation reproduction condition. Carrying all three complete banners is conservative attribution, not a determination that the broader Unlicense supersedes them.

findings.status: final participation confirmed; grant and publication already resolved November6
findings.explanation: j_rev_dct survives with a740-byte final body. Existing IJG README, attribution and modification documentation remain byte-identical; no new recovery or reissue is needed for this component.

findings.status: SHA1-family functions present in non-LTO objects but absent from all ten emitted linker CODE maps
findings.explanation: Object disassembly retains function-specific relocations: the emitted sha256/djb2 functions reference no SHA1-family functions. Compiler scanning alone overstated binary SHA1 scope. This is bounded function/GC evidence; source archives still contain SHA1 and published FPL notices are retained.

Eight linker-addressed static data intervals match the final WASM active memory image byte-for-byte. Four are Atari NTSC preset records and four are Altirra arrays. This establishes retained incorporated data; it does not claim those source TUs emit surviving functions.

publicationBoundary.newMaterialsState: Prepared in repository and conditional package/source/flat-sidecar helper. Publication is a separate operation and receipt. The prior published receipt remains immutable.

remainingGaps.explanation: Positive final witnesses exist in the three probed builds. Existing standalone package notice files and the consolidated recovered-notices ZIP lack these full component grants/attributions and full GNU license texts. In particular the xxHash, tracker and RAR incorporated BSD banners expressly address binary documentation/materials. These texts remain in or linked from source/audit evidence; a complete standalone binary-material consolidation is still needed. This batch prepares only the specifically identified Caprice/M6502 materials and does not certify all third-party notice coverage.

The58 existing modern/legacy matrix scopes remain an overlapping source-based inventory. Positive witnesses now narrow several scopes in3 builds; the other7 custom builds and unproven header-only/inlined/name-ambiguous ranges do not have a complete final-origin map. A missing witness is not an absence finding.
The50 upstream core rebuild/source pairs are not a complete per-component notice matrix. Exact runtime reconstruction does not by itself resolve all incorporated grants or final-code notice scope.

Selected SDK members and recipe sources remain covered by prior SDK link evidence. Independent SDK archive reconstruction is owned by the parallel root work; this component report makes no new SDK reconstruction claim.
The existing48/50 upstream byte matches and two mismatches are investigated separately. Notice/source evidence must not be presented as resolving those runtime mismatches.
